topic: Wire Substitution for Repairs and Maintenance
syllabus_extract: Wire Substitution for Repairs and Maintenance.
specific_objectives: 19.1.1.1Trainee will be able to explain aircraft wiring and Causes of wiring degradation.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of wire stripping, insulation removal, and conductor matching using dummy wire samples; Safety: Ensure no live circuits, wear eye protection; Supervision: Instructor verifies gauge and material match before trainee proceeds.
intro_questions: What are the primary causes of aircraft wiring degradation?
How does wire substitution impact overall aircraft electrical integrity?
Why is matching wire gauge critical during repair procedures?

development.content:
Definition of wire substitution
Standards for wire replacement
Material compatibility requirements
Insulation type selection
Conductor strand matching

Identification of wire degradation
Selection of replacement wire
Stripping and preparation techniques
Termination methods for repairs
Insulation restoration procedures

Quality inspection criteria
Documentation of repairs
Common errors in substitution
Preventive maintenance measures
Safety checks post-repair

summary_questions: Explain the relationship between wire gauge and current carrying capacity in substitution.
Describe the steps required to ensure a repaired wire meets safety standards.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the hazards of improper wire routing and protection, linking findings to the next lesson plan (LP 09) on wire routing hazards.

pft_rows.syllabus: Explanation on Wire routing and protection hazards.
